candidates.title: The Reversed Trail Map
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the rescue map led volunteers away from the shelter before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they followed the marked turns twice, but both paths ended at the same fence; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the compass rose had been printed backward on the replacement sheet; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they corrected the orientation and marked the verified route to the shelter, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Shared Water Tank
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered two gardens received too little water from their shared tank before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they opened both taps wider, but the tank emptied even faster; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a hidden leak beneath the connecting pipe was wasting the supply; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they patched the pipe and agreed on a fair watering schedule, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Late Festival Clock
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the tower clock announced the festival an hour too late before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they reset the hands, but the clock fell behind again by noon; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the pendulum was brushing a loose banner on each swing; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they moved the banner and checked the clock against the town bell, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
